qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sole-source UK nuclear submarine shipyard (Barrow-in-Furness) and sovereign defense contracts with inflation escalation and cost-recovery mechanisms provide durable pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). Indispensable UK defense prime with sovereign submarine monopoly, but rejected at Gate 6 as net debt surged to £4.95B following the debt-funded $5.5B Ball Aerospace acquisition alongside legacy pension obligations and through-cycle ROIC below 9%.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-decade defense backlogs and AUKUS submarine program, but net debt expanded from £1.0B in FY23 to £4.95B in FY24 due to debt-financed acquisition of Ball Aerospace. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC averages 7.5%-8.5%, falling short of self-funded compounding requirements without leverage.
